name: Shogun's Seal
description: The golden hanko imperial wax seal of the Shogunate, granting sovereign authority over province trade.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a monumental square imperial Shogun wax seal stamp handle topped with a dragon carving and vermilion red ink base. Centered completely inside a giant solid flat bright crimson red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Sharp clean vector design, duotone black and crimson, no 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
